description: This file defines the StorelessUnivariateStatistic interface, which extends UnivariateStatistic with methods for incremental updates to compute descriptive statistics without storing all data samples. It includes method signatures for incrementing the statistic with new values, retrieving the current result, clearing the state, and copying the statistic object.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Updates the internal state to include the new value d.

methods.name: incrementAll
methods.description: Adds multiple values to the statistic, starting at the beginning of the array.

methods.name: incrementAll
methods.description: Adds a subset of values from an array to the statistic, specified by start index and length.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Returns the current computed value of the statistic.

methods.name: getN
methods.description: Returns the number of values added.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the statistic.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates and returns a copy of the statistic with the same internal state.
